description: This file defines an ImageDownloader class for asynchronously downloading images from the Internet, caching them locally using hard and soft caches, and binding them to Android ImageView components. It manages download cancellation, cache purging after inactivity, and handles network operations including HTTP requests.

classes.name: ImageDownloader
classes.description: Helper class to manage asynchronous image downloading, caching, and binding to ImageView components in Android.

classes.name: DownloadedDrawable
classes.description: A custom Drawable that holds a weak reference to the download AsyncTask, used to associate download state with ImageView during asynchronous loading.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Initiates download of an image from a URL and binds it to an ImageView, using cache if available.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Overloaded method that allows specifying a cookie string for HTTP request.

methods.name: forceDownload
methods.description: Forces the download of an image regardless of cache state, setting a placeholder Drawable during download.

methods.name: resetPurgeTimer
methods.description: Resets the timer for cache automatic clearing after inactivity.

methods.name: cancelPotentialDownload
methods.description: Checks if an ongoing download for an ImageView should be canceled when starting a new one.

methods.name: getBitmapFromCache
methods.description: Retrieves a Bitmap from cache, prioritizing hard cache, then soft cache.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data from InputStream to OutputStream within download task.

methods.name: getBitmapDownloaderTask
methods.description: Retrieves the current download AsyncTask associated with an ImageView.
